{
  "obligations": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "entity",
      "role": "declaration",
      "statement": "Deliver program.vscore.json containing exactly one admitted typed entry named solve as canonical vscore/0.3 source under normative Lean vscore-semantics/0.3 and data-pipeline/0.3 serialization. Its typed input represents the JSON object {n,m,a,b}, and its result represents a single exact mathematical integer. Input n is an integer from 0 through 500, m is a positive integer, and a and b are arbitrary signed integers without magnitude bounds. Preserve the specified structure and exact ordering. Arithmetic uses unbounded mathematical integers; strings contain Unicode scalar values, with lexicographic ordering by scalar codepoints.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["delivery artifact", "typed solve entry", "input and output representations"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "program.vscore.json contains exactly one admitted typed entry named solve under the specified source, semantics and serialization profiles.",
        "The typed input represents n, m, a and b, and the output represents one exact integer with the specified structure and ordering.",
        "Arbitrary signed a and b, including magnitudes of 10^30 and larger, are represented without an added magnitude bound.",
        "String values and comparisons follow Unicode-scalar and scalar-codepoint semantics."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C2", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Artifact and entry identity."},
        {"clause_id": "C3", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Typed JSON correspondence."},
        {"clause_id": "C7", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Input fields and mathematical domains."},
        {"clause_id": "C12", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Canonical source and normative profiles."},
        {"clause_id": "C13", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Structure and ordering preservation."},
        {"clause_id": "C16", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Unbounded integer semantics."},
        {"clause_id": "C17", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "String value and ordering semantics."},
        {"clause_id": "C23", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Preserve D1 identity, role and required flag."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "D1 delivery revision metadata."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "precondition",
      "role": "assumption",
      "statement": "The input supplier provides inputs satisfying the specified JSON schema: n, m, a and b are integers, 0 <= n <= 500, and m > 0. The signed integers a and b have no magnitude bound. No additional input bounds or preconditions are imposed.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["supplied solve inputs"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Supplied inputs satisfy the stated schema, 0 <= n <= 500 and m > 0.",
        "Every signed integer a and b is permitted, without additional restrictions."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C5", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Explicit supplier assumption."},
        {"clause_id": "C7", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Schema and bounds."},
        {"clause_id": "C18", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "No additional preconditions."},
        {"clause_id": "C23", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Preserve A1 identity, role and required flag."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "A1 unchanged assumption metadata."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "N1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "explicit_non_goal",
      "role": "exclusion",
      "statement": "Behavior for malformed inputs outside the specified schema and bounds is not required.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["malformed inputs"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": ["No functional behavior is required for malformed input."],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C6", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Malformed-input behavior excluded."},
        {"clause_id": "C23", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Preserve N1 identity, exclusion role and required flag."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "N1 unchanged exclusion metadata."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "For every input satisfying A1, solve returns the exact integer sum Σ(i=0 to n-1) floor((a*i+b)/m). For each i, the floor is the unique integer q satisfying q*m <= a*i+b < (q+1)*m, including negative numerators. The empty sum for n=0 is zero. The admitted implementation must universally refine this complete mathematical specification and preserve both public examples: {a:-2,b:1,m:3,n:4} returns -4 and {a:100,b:-99,m:7,n:0} returns 0. Example agreement does not replace universal refinement.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["all inputs satisfying A1"],
      "dependencies": [
        {"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"},
        {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}
      ],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "For every valid n, m, a and b, output equals Σ(i=0 to n-1) floor((a*i+b)/m).",
        "Each quotient q satisfies q*m <= a*i+b < (q+1)*m.",
        "For every valid m, a and b, n=0 returns zero.",
        "The two public example outputs are respectively -4 and 0.",
        "Universal implementation refinement covers the complete specified domain."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C8", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact universal floor sum."},
        {"clause_id": "C9", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Floor toward negative infinity."},
        {"clause_id": "C10", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Empty sum equals zero."},
        {"clause_id": "C19", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Public example preservation."},
        {"clause_id": "C20", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Example values and universal refinement."},
        {"clause_id": "C22", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Functional meaning remains unchanged."},
        {"clause_id": "C23", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Preserve O1 identity, role and required flag."},
        {"clause_id": "C26", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Complete mathematical statement and universal refinement."},
        {"clause_id": "C27", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Examples do not replace the universal guarantee."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O1 revised delivery metadata."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "O2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "postcondition",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "The canonical solve entry has total, pure and deterministic admitted typed execution under normative Lean vscore-semantics/0.3 and data-pipeline/0.3 serialization. Every input satisfying A1 yields the specified integer result representation with exact input/output structure and ordering, without additional input restrictions. The delivery requires universal implementation refinement and unchanged delivery assurance at the requested Tier 2 restricted_source vscore/0.3 verification boundary.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["admitted typed execution", "serialization correspondence", "restricted-source delivery"],
      "dependencies": [
        {"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"},
        {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}
      ],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "Every admitted typed execution is total, pure and deterministic.",
        "Every valid input yields the required result representation with the specified structure and exact ordering.",
        "No additional input restrictions are imposed.",
        "The delivery is subject to universal refinement and the requested Tier 2 restricted_source vscore/0.3 assurance obligations."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C2", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Admitted typed solve delivery."},
        {"clause_id": "C3", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Typed input/output correspondence."},
        {"clause_id": "C12", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Canonical source, execution and serialization profiles."},
        {"clause_id": "C13", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Structure and exact ordering."},
        {"clause_id": "C14", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Totality, purity and determinism."},
        {"clause_id": "C18", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "No additional restrictions."},
        {"clause_id": "C21", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "New canonical restricted-source delivery."},
        {"clause_id": "C23", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Preserve O2 identity, role and required flag."},
        {"clause_id": "C24", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Revised typed pure source properties."},
        {"clause_id": "C25", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Unchanged delivery assurance."},
        {"clause_id": "C26", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Universal implementation refinement."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "O2 metadata and requested verification endpoint."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "S1",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "safety_property",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "The solve source performs no external I/O, reads no benchmark files and never mutates input values. Its admitted typed execution is pure in a language without external-effect constructors.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["solve source", "all admitted typed executions"],
      "dependencies": [{"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"}],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "No external I/O or benchmark-file reads occur.",
        "Input values remain immutable.",
        "The source uses the specified semantics without external-effect constructors."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C4", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "No I/O or benchmark access."},
        {"clause_id": "C14", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Pure execution."},
        {"clause_id": "C15", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Immutability and absence of external-effect constructors."},
        {"clause_id": "C23", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Preserve S1 identity, role and required flag."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "S1 revised source safety metadata."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "S2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "safety_property",
      "role": "guarantee",
      "statement": "All arithmetic used to compute the floor sum uses exact unbounded mathematical integers without floating point, finite-width overflow or precision loss.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["floor-sum arithmetic", "all inputs satisfying A1"],
      "dependencies": [
        {"id": "D1", "relation": "uses_definition"},
        {"id": "A1", "relation": "assumes"}
      ],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "No floating-point arithmetic is used.",
        "Intermediate values and the output use exact unbounded integer semantics.",
        "Arbitrarily large signed a and b incur no overflow or precision loss."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C8", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Exact arithmetic result."},
        {"clause_id": "C11", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Avoid floating point."},
        {"clause_id": "C16", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Unbounded mathematical integers."},
        {"clause_id": "C23", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Preserve S2 identity, role and required flag."},
        {"clause_id": "C29", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "S2 unchanged arithmetic safety metadata."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "N2",
      "revision": 1,
      "kind": "explicit_non_goal",
      "role": "exclusion",
      "statement": "Runtime campaigns and machine-code, compiler, runtime and physical-resource assurance are outside the requested scope. Assurance covers normative restricted-source execution only, explicitly trusting natural-language correspondence, host tooling, the pinned Lean kernel, hashing and OS/hardware.",
      "required": true,
      "scope": ["verification boundary", "excluded campaigns and assurance"],
      "dependencies": [],
      "acceptance_criteria": [
        "No runtime campaign is required.",
        "No machine-code, compiler, runtime or physical-resource assurance is claimed.",
        "The restricted-source assurance boundary records all explicitly trusted components."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {"clause_id": "C30", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Runtime campaigns excluded."},
        {"clause_id": "C31", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Restricted-source boundary and explicit trust."},
        {"clause_id": "C32", "origin": "explicit", "interpretation": "Excluded assurance layers."}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "category_review": {
    "entities": "D1 declares the artifact, typed entry, representations and normative value semantics.",
    "preconditions": "A1 records only the explicitly supplied schema and bounds.",
    "postconditions": "O1 specifies the universal signed floor sum; O2 specifies total pure deterministic typed execution and serialization.",
    "invariants": "Input immutability is covered by S1.",
    "safety_properties": "S1 prohibits effects and mutation; S2 requires exact unbounded integer arithmetic.",
    "liveness_properties": "Total execution is covered by O2.",
    "resource_constraints": "No physical-resource assurance or constraint is requested.",
    "error_semantics": "Malformed-input behavior is excluded by N1.",
    "explicit_non_goals": "N1 excludes malformed-input behavior; N2 records excluded campaigns and assurance layers.",
    "ambiguities": "None requiring resolution."
  },
  "clauses": [
    {"clause_id": "C1", "disposition": "context", "refs": [], "note": "Task identifier and title."},
    {"clause_id": "C2", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "O2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C3", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "O2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C4", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["S1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C5", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["A1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C6", "disposition": "exclusion", "refs": ["N1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C7", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "A1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C8", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O1", "S2"], "note": ""},

    {"clause_id": "C10", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O1"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C11", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["S2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C12", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "O2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C13", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "O2"], "note": ""},

    {"clause_id": "C23", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "A1", "O1", "O2", "S1", "S2"], "note": "All listed identities, roles and required flags are preserved, including N1 as an exclusion recorded under C6."},
    {"clause_id": "C24", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C25", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C26", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["O1", "O2"], "note": ""},

    {"clause_id": "C28", "disposition": "context", "refs": [], "note": "Offsets refer to revised source text; citations use current manifest IDs."},
    {"clause_id": "C29", "disposition": "obligations", "refs": ["D1", "A1", "O1", "O2", "S1", "S2"], "note": "Preserve all listed metadata, including the N1 exclusion covered by C6, and the requested verification endpoint without claiming an achieved lifecycle state."},
    {"clause_id": "C30", "disposition": "exclusion", "refs": ["N2"], "note": ""},
    {"clause_id": "C31", "disposition": "exclusion", "refs": ["N2"], "note": "Restricted-source assurance boundary and explicitly trusted components."},
    {"clause_id": "C32", "disposition": "exclusion", "refs": ["N2"], "note": ""}
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "supplied_by": "input supplier",
      "discharged_at": "solve invocation, where supplied inputs satisfy the specified JSON schema and bounds"
    }
  ],
  "ambiguities": [],
  "selected_defaults": []
}
